review.evidence: Exact USDfr grant/revoke event replay identifies only MintRedeemController 0x50ac018eb6400f247ffe0fa7f1d4e0e900cdb47c as MINTER and the timelock 0x28b36b6a48ed3f7409464c811a9ed538a824120e as DEFAULT_ADMIN/UPGRADER. The complete AttestationOracle history and membership checks at block 26110192 identify two attester keys, 0x759c2cd90594fdb114c5d37c5c3ea78a0033ed35 and 0xe2e544eded1189b8a5bda86a6f474011a397efb0; threshold is one for kinds 0/1 and two for kinds 2-9. Continuous ledger reconciliation is accounting, not financial assurance of receivables. The on-chain ReserveManager invariant and issuer-approved loan marks establish internal-ledger accounting only, not independent reconciliation of the material offchain book to total token liabilities, so no continuous financial-reconciliation rung is credited. Rechecked security disclosure includes Medium/Open LMV-18 from Round 75, in addition to LMV-09, LMV-11 and LMV-12..16. LMV-17 was withdrawn/refuted and is not a confirmed High finding. No remediation/retest closure is claimed. Attester key custody remains unverified despite the observed two-key roster and thresholds. Executed offchain collateral and token holder-priority instruments, and independent remediation/retest evidence for open economic findings, remain unavailable; these are backing/economic-loss gaps rather than an incomplete token mint-role census. Upstream governance-treasury/operations Safe signer and bypass closure remains incomplete: these upstream controllers have not been enumerated, so the complete mint/upgrade control census remains unresolved despite the named downstream governance timelock.
